clue.text: Border cut off in fog that swirls? It's ominous

indicators.note: something that swirls is churned round, so these letters are mixed into a new order
cut off says the last letter of the word Border is chopped away

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A frontier vanishes into thick swirling mist, and the scene feels threatening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut off' trims Border to BORDE; 'that swirls' then shakes BORDE with IN and FOG into the answer. 'It's' simply introduces the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, the word describes something that portends evil, which is what ominous means.

clue.text: Thick English lot

parts.note: thick in the sense of stout or plump means fat

explanation.surface: A dim-witted bunch of English people.
explanation.definitionFit: One's lot is one's destiny or fortune in life, a synonym.

clue.text: Series of calls ahead for collection of data

parts.note: a doctor's or milkman's round is a series of calls made in turn
being up means ahead, as a team leading a game

explanation.surface: Someone makes a string of phone calls in advance to gather information.
explanation.definitionFit: A summary gathering together news or information is called by this name, as in a news bulletin's closing summary.

clue.text: Mercenary lawman in mutinous ship, on watch

indicators.note: in a down clue on means the second piece is placed after the first

parts.note: HMS Bounty was the ship whose crew mutinied against Captain Bligh in 1789
a hunter is a pocket watch with a hinged cover protecting the face

explanation.surface: A hired enforcer aboard a ship of mutineers is keeping a lookout.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tracks down fugitives for a reward is a paid, mercenary pursuer of outlaws.

clue.text: Does might dominate in this area?

definitions.text: Does might dominate in this area?

parts.words: Does might dominate in this area
parts.note: does are female deer, so an enclosure where they abound is described

explanation.walkthrough: 'Does' looks like the verb, but it is the plural of doe, a female deer.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosed parkland stocked with deer is where does would be the most numerous animals.

clue.text: Finesse diamonds in no trumps play finally

indicators.note: in places the diamonds word inside the abbreviation for no trumps

parts.note: NT is the bridge abbreviation for no trumps
ice is slang for diamonds

indicators.note: finally picks out the closing letter of the word play

explanation.surface: A bridge player shows skill by finessing in diamonds during a no-trumps hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine point or subtle detail of conduct is a matter of finesse.

clue.text: Crawling son, small

parts.note: low can mean small, as in a low number

explanation.surface: A small boy creeping along on all fours.
explanation.definitionFit: Crawling describes moving at a snail's pace, as traffic does, a synonym.

clue.text: Greek character hosting a dance

indicators.note: hosting means the Greek letter takes the other piece in as its guest

parts.note: lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man entertains guests at a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast Brazilian partner dance popular around 1990, so an example of a dance.

clue.text: It shows with roaming around lands? True

definitions.text: It shows with roaming around lands? True

indicators.note: roaming around suggests wandering about, so these letters are moved into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A traveller's longing is revealed by their roaming from land to land.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'True' at the end looks like a confirming remark, but it is anagram fodder; the whole clue also describes the urge itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong desire to travel shows itself in roaming around different countries.

clue.text: Aggression of copper facing short man, interrupting suspension of hostilities

indicators.note: interrupting means the inner pieces break into the middle of the ceasefire word

parts.note: a truce is a pause in fighting

indicators.note: facing puts the copper symbol directly before the man's name

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
Len is a shortened form of the man's name Leonard

explanation.surface: A policeman confronts a small man, ruining a ceasefire through his aggressive conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: Truculence is eagerness to fight or argue, a fierce aggressiveness.

clue.text: Part of boom anticipated in ME state

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An expected economic boom in a Middle Eastern country.
explanation.walkthrough: ME is the usual abbreviation for the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultanate on the Arabian Peninsula, so it is a nation in the Middle East.

clue.text: Precise moment to indicate cross-country event

parts.note: a point in time is an exact moment
to point is to indicate

explanation.surface: Someone asks for the exact time when a cross-country race will be shown.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse race over fences across open country from one landmark to another.

clue.text: Aspect of sea recalled? That's correct

indicators.note: recalled read as called back means the word is turned backwards

parts.note: the tide is a feature of the sea's rise and fall

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a remembered view of the ocean is accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: To revise text and remove errors is to correct it, a synonym.

clue.text: A port that's dilapidated with new decline in custom

indicators.note: something dilapidated is fallen to pieces, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: to age is to decline with the years

explanation.surface: A run-down harbour, with a new slump in its trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Custom in the sense of regular business from customers, the support a shop enjoys.

clue.text: Claim in Catholic feast

definitions.meaning: taking something for granted, a presumption or claim
the feast of the Virgin Mary taken up into heaven, celebrated on 15 August

explanation.definitionFit: One word for both a presumption assumed to be true and the Marian feast day on 15 August.

clue.text: Mobile accessory in county is precious item

indicators.note: in means the accessory goes inside the county

parts.note: shire is an old word for an English county
an app is software added to a mobile phone

explanation.surface: A phone add-on used in a rural county counts as a treasured possession.
explanation.definitionFit: A blue gemstone, so an example of a precious item.

clue.text: Call for dog to follow directions

indicators.note: to follow puts the dog word after the compass points

parts.note: E and N are the compass directions east and north
to dog someone is to tail or shadow them

explanation.surface: A command telling a dog to trail along behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To necessitate or involve something is to call for it as a consequence.

clue.text: False pay suspected? Act cautiously

indicators.note: suspected read as distrusted marks the letters as not to be taken at face value but rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone suspecting a fake wage packet decides to tread carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid risks is to behave with caution, an idiom.

clue.text: Smooth day leaving SA city to east

indicators.note: to means the next piece is added on at the end
leaving means the day abbreviation departs from the city name

parts.note: Durban is a city in South Africa

explanation.surface: A calm day spent leaving a South African city, heading east.
explanation.definitionFit: Polished and suave in manner, which is smooth in the sense of socially assured.

clue.text: Party almost packed for one among celebrated seven

parts.note: a bash is an informal party

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the packed word is dropped

parts.note: full means packed or crowded

explanation.surface: A crowded party is nearly full, and one guest belongs to a famous group of seven.
explanation.walkthrough: The celebrated seven are the Seven Dwarfs of Snow White, of whom this one is shy.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the Seven Dwarfs in Disney's Snow White, so a member of that famous group.

clue.text: Aquatic creature wrongly put, say, behind empty pool

indicators.note: behind places the rearranged letters after the pool's shell
empty removes the inside, keeping only the outer letters of pool
wrongly says these letters are put together the wrong way, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone misplaces something behind a drained swimming pool where an animal swims.
explanation.definitionFit: The duck-billed mammal of Australian rivers spends much of its life in water.

clue.text: Saw car in lead

indicators.note: in means the car goes inside the symbol for lead

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
Rover is a British make of car

explanation.surface: A car sitting in lead-polluted surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying, a synonym for a proverb.

clue.text: Very little in official memorandum

definitions.meaning: a written note recording proceedings, as of a meeting

explanation.definitionFit: One spelling serves as both an adjective for tiny and a noun for a formal written record.

clue.text: People in general who succeed?

parts.note: succeed read as come after, meaning all those who follow in future generations

explanation.walkthrough: 'succeed' looks like achieving success, but here it means come after.
explanation.definitionFit: All future generations together are the people who will succeed, or follow, us.

clue.text: Work painstakingly — is it 'PC'?

definitions.meaning: to trudge on at a task slowly and steadily
The policeman in Enid Blyton's Noddy books, so a slang term for a police constable

explanation.walkthrough: PC is a police constable, the lowest police rank in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: One word for laboring steadily and the British slang name for a police constable from the Noddy stories.

clue.text: Man perhaps deceived having left tips

indicators.note: having left tips means both end letters have been dropped

parts.note: misled means deceived

explanation.surface: Someone was fooled into leaving no gratuities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea; 'perhaps' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is an island, so Man is an example of one.

clue.text: Instant judge barred suspect

indicators.note: barred means the judge letter is kept out of the word

parts.note: a jiffy is an instant

explanation.surface: A judge was instantly banned from court on suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubtful or questionable, an informal synonym for suspect as an adjective.

clue.text: European wearing sequins as fashionable? Uncomfortable feeling

indicators.note: wearing means the rearranged letters are put on around the European letter
fashionable read as fashioned or shaped hints the letters are reworked

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A European wearing sequins asks if this is stylish, feeling self-conscious.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea or unease is an uncomfortable feeling in the stomach or mind.

clue.text: A German returns to cross lake and river

indicators.note: to cross means the reversed word spans over the lake letter
returns means the German word is read backwards

parts.note: ein is German for a

explanation.surface: A German comes back to cross a lake and a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The longest river in Africa, so an example of a river.

clue.text: Lovely daughter with quality needed for a popular party

parts.words: quality needed for a popular party
parts.note: a party must be able to win votes, so it must be fit to be elected

explanation.surface: A charming girl has what a party needs to win.
explanation.definitionFit: Delicious or delightful, so a synonym for lovely.
